# Prime Property client API

API base: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/v1
OpenAPI 3.1: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/docs/openapi.json
Human API docs: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/docs
Guest frontend flow: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/docs/guest-flow
Guest flow Markdown: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/docs/guest-flow.md
Guest flow JSON: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/docs/guest-flow.json
Language discovery: https://primeproperty.cfd/api/v1/languages

Authentication uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens have the `client` ability, are named per device, and expire after 30 days. Web-session login behavior and `LoginResponse` are not part of this API.

Only properties with `property_details.status=active` are visible from v1, including related, suggested, home, map, favorite, and enquiry operations. Articles must be published. Invalid supplied bearer tokens receive 401 even on optionally authenticated endpoints.

Supported locales are en, my, th, and zh. Supported layouts are guest and guest_v2. Translation dictionaries fill missing keys from English and report those missing keys in metadata.

The `/` web route renders the Livewire `HomePage`. `resources/views/welcome.blade.php` is unused starter markup. Existing bot, Telegram, tag-search, map-bounds, and web authentication routes are operational but outside the public v1 contract.
